acceptanceCriteria: Under a synthetic writer-contention test, a timed-out attached run exits 124 or 127, never 1/MALFORMED.
The envelope carries one run item whenever the command was started.
A deadline-exceeded store write maps to a documented retryable code (for example LOCK_TIMEOUT), not MALFORMED.
The outcome write is retried within the cleanup bound before giving up.
V1-1558: claim --detach ceiling expiry or SIGINT reports the same documented stable code, not MALFORMED.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1026 (owner, 2026-10-17), confirmed by the owner's reproduction on main 55abb815: `corvint-tasks run --attempt ID --generation G --timeout 40 -- sleep 300` (attached) under heavy writer contention returned exit 1, envelope ERROR, codes [MALFORMED], warning 'context deadline exceeded', items [] after ~150 s; also with --timeout 3. The child group was reaped but no run outcome is recorded on the attempt. A normal exit on the same attempt returned 3/EXIT. The attempt-runner spec reserves 124 for timeout and 127 for outcome-not-recorded; MALFORMED/1 is for pre-launch refusals. Same class as V1-1558 (claim --detach ceiling/SIGINT -> MALFORMED 'context deadline exceeded'); fix both by mapping a deadline-exceeded or cancelled store write to a documented retryable code and never reporting MALFORMED after launch. Expected: timeout exits 124; failed outcome write exits 127 with the write's code; the outcome write is retried within the cleanup bound.
title: run: a timed-out attached run exits 1 MALFORMED 'context deadline exceeded' under store contention instead of 124/127 (GitHub #1026)
